description: Source-size ratchet for the editor and command modules (forma-studio#18). Limits are line counts and may only decrease; EditorConformanceTests enforces them. A file may exceed its limit, or a limit may exceed the ceiling, only under an exception with an owner, a reason, a revisit trigger and an expiry date. Lower limits with FORMA_STUDIO_UPDATE_GENERATED=1 (it never raises one).

exceptions.reason: The ~350-line view projection was moved out of EditorApp unchanged so the extraction stayed behavior-preserving; splitting it into per-panel projections (canvas, structure, inspector, layout, workflows, export, review) is the next step of forma-studio#18.
exceptions.revisit: Before any new panel or view field is added, or by the expiry date, whichever comes first.
